title_en: Mestia, one lane at a time
description_en: Start with the town around you. Follow Mestia's lanes, look closely at a Svan house and leave room for the museum rather than rushing past it on the way to a mountain.
details_en: A short cultural outing built around the Svaneti Museum of History and Ethnography and Mestia's older neighbourhoods. A visit to the Margiani house museum can be arranged if it is open. The order stays flexible, with a seated break and time for questions. Interiors and any tower access depend on the host; this is a living town, not an open-air set.
itinerary_en:
Suggested half-day plan; timings are planning allowances.
First 30 minutes: meet in Mestia and agree the walking pace.
Next 60–90 minutes: Svaneti Museum visit, subject to opening.
Next 60–90 minutes: neighbourhood walk and optional Margiani house museum.
Final 30 minutes: a break and return to the agreed point. Adjust stops for opening times and the group's pace.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: a locally accompanied town walk and help coordinating museum visits. The written quote confirms guide availability, language, transport if needed and which entry tickets are included.
exclusions_en: Meals, drinks, museum or private-house entry and transport are not included unless named in the quote. No automatic access to private towers or homes.
requirements_en: Comfortable shoes for uneven lanes and steps. Tell us about walking or access needs before the route is agreed. Ask before photographing people or entering homes and religious spaces.
season_en: Possible throughout the year when town access and the chosen museums permit. Opening days are checked for your date.
difficulty: Gentle pace; uneven lanes and steps
meeting_point_en: An agreed point in Mestia, confirmed with the quote. Hotel pickup is only included if stated.
weather_en: Light rain can suit a museum-first plan. Icy streets or heavy weather may mean a shorter walk and more indoor time. If access or museum opening prevents a worthwhile visit, agree another date or a revised plan before setting out.
walking_en: Short walks with breaks; distance and steps depend on the agreed museums and starting point. An accessible route needs individual planning.
driving_en: Normally a town-based outing. Any vehicle support is arranged and priced separately.
operator_notes: Research draft: approve the route with the actual guide. Confirm museum opening, entry charges and house-museum host access directly. Do not promise a private tower climb, a performance, a family meal or wheelchair access without specific agreement. Half-day timing is an original planning allowance.

title_en: Above Mestia, with time to sit and look
description_en: Take the lift toward Zuruldi and let the town fall away below. A little walking, a long look at the skyline and enough time to stop without watching the clock.
details_en: A gentle view day using the Hatsvali–Zuruldi lift route when the operator has it running. Walking near the upper station stays short and is agreed around the group's ability and the ground conditions. This outing does not include a long ridge traverse. Clear views depend on the weather; the lift itself also needs checking for your date.
itinerary_en:
Suggested 2–4 hour outing; lift queues and access affect the timing.
Start: meet in Mestia after checking lift status.
Next stage: reach the operating lower station by the agreed means and ride up.
Allow roughly an hour above: short walk, photographs and a break, returning well before the operator's last descent.
Finish: descend and return to the agreed meeting point.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: coordination of a lift-based view outing and optional local accompaniment. The quote specifies lift tickets, transfers and guiding; none is included by assumption.
exclusions_en: Food, drinks, lift passes and station transfers unless listed in the quote. No ski lesson, ridge expedition or guaranteed mountain panorama.
requirements_en: Shoes with grip and a warm outer layer. Discuss steps, lift boarding and mobility needs before booking. Children need adult supervision near the station and on the walk.
season_en: June–September is the target summer window, only while the relevant lifts are operating. The calendar is guidance, not an opening schedule. Other dates need a separate check.
difficulty: Short walk; lift boarding and uneven ground
meeting_point_en: Mestia; the exact meeting point and access to the operating station are confirmed in advance.
weather_en: Do not depart on the assumption that lifts will reopen. If wind, maintenance or poor conditions close the route, agree a Mestia museum-and-lanes outing or another date. A long walk up the mountain is not the automatic substitute.
walking_en: Short, optional walks near the upper station. No fixed distance: select a turnaround for the group and conditions.
driving_en: Station access depends on which lift sections are running. Any road transfer and its pickup point must be specified in the quote.
operator_notes: Research draft. MTA confirms historical summer operation, but its June 2025 opening and hours must not be treated as the current timetable. Check both connecting lift sections, weather, last descent, ticketing and station access directly. Confirm any accompanying guide. Duration and modest walking scope are proposed planning choices.

title_en: Chalaadi: through the forest toward the ice
description_en: Follow the river out of Mestia, then leave the vehicle behind. The walk begins in woodland and opens onto a rougher valley, with the glacier ahead and time to take it in.
details_en: A transfer-assisted walk to a safe Chalaadi viewpoint, returning by the same path. Expect forest trail followed by rocky ground. The guide chooses where to stop according to conditions. This is a glacier-view walk, with no travel on the ice or approach underneath its edge.
itinerary_en:
Suggested morning outing, allowing 4–5 hours rather than a fixed departure schedule.
Start: pickup in Mestia and trail briefing.
Allow about 30–45 minutes for the outward drive, adjusted by the driver.
Next 2–3 hours: walk out and back with a viewpoint stop and breaks.
Keep the remaining time for a slower walking pace and the return drive. Turn back earlier if the valley conditions deteriorate.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: return trailhead transport and an accompanied walk. These require a confirmed vehicle and walking guide; the written quote lists the actual inclusions and language.
exclusions_en: Meals, personal walking equipment and travel insurance unless expressly stated. Ice walking, climbing and glacier equipment are outside this route.
requirements_en: Ability to walk for several hours over uneven stones. Bring grippy walking footwear, waterproofs, a warm layer, drinking water and a snack. Discuss the route's suitability for children or anyone with balance or mobility difficulties before confirmation.
season_en: June–September is the planned core window. May and October are considered only after local checks of snow, the trail and road access.
meeting_point_en: Agreed Mestia pickup point; the walking start is the bridge trailhead, not Mestia town centre.
weather_en: Rain, fog, unsafe river or bridge conditions, or signs of rockfall mean this route does not proceed. Agree a Mestia cultural outing, another date or a revised booking. The viewpoint may be moved back; reaching the ice is never a goal.
walking_en: Approximately 6 km return from the drive-assisted trailhead, with about 280 m net climb on the planned route. The actual turnaround varies for safety; walking all the way from Mestia is a different, longer outing.
driving_en: Return drive from Mestia to the bridge trailhead. Allow roughly 30–45 minutes each way as a planning estimate; access and road condition may change the timing.
operator_notes: Approve after confirming the actual walking guide, vehicle, trailhead access and return arrangement. Svaneti DMO provides the clearest drive-assisted 6 km route; GNTA's distance description mixes starts, so do not import its longer figure. Both official tourism sources warn about ice/stonefall. Core months and buffered duration are planning judgments, not official opening dates. Do not repeat competitor claims inviting guests close to the ice.

title_en: Koruldi on foot: earn the wide view
description_en: Start in Mestia and spend the day climbing into open country. The pools are small; the mountain skyline is anything but. This one is for people who enjoy a long uphill walk.
details_en: A full return hike from town, with an early start, a steady pace and a firm turnaround. It is a different outing from the 4×4 visit. Leave the evening free: tired legs and a slower descent deserve more room than a tight onward connection.
itinerary_en:
Suggested full-day plan, normally 7–9 hours including breaks.
Early morning: meet in Mestia, review conditions and begin the climb.
Morning: steady ascent with breaks and a progress check at the viewpoint above town.
Middle of the day: continue toward the lakes only if pace, weather and visibility leave a comfortable return margin.
Afternoon: retrace the route to Mestia. The agreed turnaround time takes priority over reaching the lakes.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: a walking guide for the entire return hike. Availability, language and any additional arrangements must appear in the written quote.
exclusions_en: Vehicle transport, packed lunch, drinks, personal walking equipment and travel insurance unless listed. A vehicle collection is not a guaranteed shortcut if someone becomes tired.
requirements_en: Recent experience of full-day hillwalking and sustained climbing. Bring lunch, sufficient drinking water for the whole route, waterproofs, warm layers and reliable footwear. Tell the operator about relevant fitness or access concerns before the plan is accepted.
season_en: July–September core window. Earlier or later dates require a new assessment of snow, daylight and the upper route; they are not routine departures.
meeting_point_en: Mestia town; exact walking start and early meeting time confirmed after the route briefing.
weather_en: Snow on the intended trail, thunderstorms, strong winds or poor visibility can rule out the upper route. Agree a lower walk only if conditions there are suitable, otherwise reschedule. Reaching the town viewpoint does not commit the group to the lakes.
walking_en: Allow approximately 16 km return and 1,240 m of climb from Mestia. Allow a full day; measured distance varies with the town start and path chosen. The walk starts in town, not halfway up by vehicle.
driving_en: No driving is planned. A separate 4×4 outing is available as a different proposal, subject to vehicle and track checks.
operator_notes: Confirm the walking guide, group's experience, turnaround time and emergency arrangements. Grade by the substantial climb rather than the source's casual 'simple' label. Do not assume a drinkable water source or an available rescue vehicle. Duration and the conservative core season are original planning allowances informed by the route and regional snow pattern.

title_en: Koruldi by 4×4, a little higher above Mestia
description_en: Take the mountain track up from town and save your walking for the open ground above. Stop, stretch your legs and make space for a quiet half-hour with the skyline.
details_en: A vehicle-based outing with short optional walks, planned separately from the full Koruldi hike. The journey uses a rough mountain track and is part of the day, not merely a transfer. The intended stops depend on the driver's assessment; a capable vehicle does not make a closed or unsafe track usable.
itinerary_en:
Suggested 3–4 hour outing, with the final schedule agreed by the driver.
Start: meet in Mestia and review the track and forecast.
Ascent: drive with a stretch stop at a suitable viewpoint.
Upper stop: time on foot near the lakes if access and conditions allow.
Return: descend to Mestia with buffer for slower road conditions. There is no automatic extension into a long hike.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: a suitable vehicle with driver for the return outing. The quote states the vehicle arrangement, passenger limit, stops and whether a separate guide is included.
exclusions_en: Meals, drinks and any walking guide unless specified. No off-road self-driving, long guided hike or guaranteed clear view.
requirements_en: Comfort with a bumpy mountain drive. Tell us before booking about motion sickness, difficulty boarding a vehicle, child-seat needs or other relevant concerns. Bring walking shoes and a warm layer even if you plan little walking.
season_en: July–September core window. June and early October are conditional on snow, track condition and local approval.
meeting_point_en: Confirmed pickup in Mestia. Vehicle and seating arrangements are agreed before accepting the booking.
weather_en: Snow, ice, heavy rain, an unstable track or poor visibility can prevent the upper drive. A lower stop is an option only after the driver checks it and the guest agrees. Otherwise choose a town outing or another date.
walking_en: Optional short walks near the stops. Around the upper lakes the terrain is uneven and the altitude is roughly 2,700 m; limited walking does not remove that exposure.
driving_en: Return mountain-track drive from Mestia. The 3–4 hour overall allowance includes stops and is a proposal, not a guaranteed driving time.
operator_notes: Confirm a locally experienced driver, appropriate vehicle, legal seating, child restraints if needed and same-day track assessment. TravelMestia supplies market evidence for a separate vehicle product, but its page has inconsistent timings and seasons; use the buffered estimate and confirm locally. Do not copy its capacity, prices, inclusions or claims about fitness suitability.

title_en: Ushguli, without watching the clock at every stop
description_en: Follow the valley east for a day among tower houses, village lanes and a much bigger horizon. Leave time for lunch and a look around before taking the road back to Mestia.
details_en: A village-focused day through the Enguri valley, including the historic setting of Chazhashi and the Lamaria area when access permits. The itinerary allows time to walk and pause rather than adding a full glacier hike. Shkhara may come into view in clear weather. Buildings are still used by residents, and private interiors are visited only by agreement.
itinerary_en:
Suggested 7–8 hour day, with timing adjusted to road conditions.
Morning: leave Mestia after the driver checks access; make only suitable roadside stops.
Late morning to early afternoon: village walk, Chazhashi and the Lamaria area; leave a proper lunch break.
Afternoon: return along the same valley with daylight and a road-delay buffer.
A full Shkhara hike belongs in the separate overnight itinerary, not as a rushed add-on.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: return transport and a village visit. The quote confirms vehicle, driver, any accompanying guide and entry arrangements. A lunch stop does not mean lunch is included.
exclusions_en: Meals, drinks, entry to private towers or museums and guiding unless specified. No Shkhara glacier walk, guaranteed church interior or promised mountain visibility.
requirements_en: Walking shoes for uneven lanes, a warm layer and waterproofs. Discuss limited mobility, child-seat requirements and tolerance of a winding road before confirming. Respect local homes and religious access rules.
season_en: June–September is the core planning window. May and October need local access checks. Winter requests are assessed individually rather than sold as a guaranteed year-round departure.
meeting_point_en: An agreed Mestia pickup point and morning departure, confirmed with the driver.
weather_en: Road restrictions, rockfall, unsafe snow or ice, or a deteriorating forecast can stop the trip. Agree a Mestia cultural day or another date before departure. A 4×4 is not permission to drive through a restriction.
walking_en: Flexible village walks with breaks; no fixed trekking distance. Steeper optional paths and building steps are discussed on the day.
driving_en: Return drive along the Mestia–Ushguli valley road. Reserve a substantial part of the day for driving and stops; the driver confirms timing after checking current conditions.
operator_notes: Confirm vehicle, driver, access, opening arrangements and any guide before activation. UNESCO evidence concerns the Upper Svaneti property centred on Chazhashi; avoid claiming all of Mestia is UNESCO-listed or repeating a disputed 'highest village in Europe' superlative. Roads Department's 2026 rockfall notice demonstrates possible disruption, not a continuing closure. Check live restrictions separately. Day length is an original buffer above competitor format.

title_en: Stay in Ushguli, walk toward Shkhara
description_en: Stay after the day-trip cars leave. With a night in Ushguli, there is room for the village first and a proper walk into the valley the next morning.
details_en: Two days from Mestia with one confirmed guesthouse night in Ushguli. The second day follows the valley toward a safe view of Shkhara Glacier, returning the same way. It is a long walking day before the drive back; a second Ushguli night can be quoted for a slower pace. No part of this plan goes onto the glacier.
itinerary_en:
Day 1: morning transfer from Mestia, allowing for road stops and delays. Spend the afternoon in the villages and check into the pre-arranged guesthouse. Agree the next day's turnaround and packed lunch.
Day 2: early breakfast and departure on foot. Allow 5–6 hours for the full return walk, including breaks, subject to the guide's assessment. Return to the guesthouse for bags and meet the pre-arranged vehicle. Keep a daylight margin for the drive to Mestia.
If the group's pace cannot leave that margin, shorten the walk; an extra night is possible only if separately confirmed.
inclusions_en: Proposed package scope: Mestia return transport, one Ushguli guesthouse night and a walking guide on day 2. Every supplier and inclusion, including room arrangement and meals, must be confirmed in the quote before the package is accepted.
exclusions_en: Meals, packed lunch, drinks, private entry fees, personal equipment and insurance unless expressly included. No glacier travel, horseback ride or extra guesthouse night by default.
requirements_en: Comfortable with a full day on foot and simple guesthouse accommodation. Bring walking footwear, warm and rain layers, water and a small daypack. Tell us about dietary needs and room requirements early; options depend on the confirmed host.
season_en: July–September core window. June and October requests need individual trail, stream, daylight and road checks.
duration: 2 days / 1 night; longer option by agreement
difficulty: Moderate to demanding; long walking day
meeting_point_en: Mestia pickup on day 1; Ushguli walking start on day 2. Final meeting times depend on the confirmed host, guide and driver.
weather_en: High streams, poor visibility, rockfall concerns or unsafe road conditions can change this plan. The walking guide may use a shorter safe valley turnaround. A village day, delayed departure or extra night needs agreement and availability; it is not an automatic included substitute. Never approach unstable ice to complete the itinerary.
walking_en: Full Ushguli return route is approximately 16 km, normally 5–6 hours. Stream crossings and a rougher final section require care. The safe viewpoint and turnaround can reduce the distance.
driving_en: Mestia–Ushguli on day 1 and return after walking on day 2. Do not schedule a tight onward connection from Mestia on the return evening.
operator_notes: Approve only after obtaining actual guesthouse, vehicle and walking-guide availability. Record room type, meal scope, cancellation terms and contingency costs in the quote. DMO supports distance and stream hazards; GNTA supports walking time and season. The two-day packaging and turnaround buffer are original planning judgments. Guesthouses here are separate suppliers, not assumed Riverside Svaneti inventory.

title_en: Mazeri and the sound of Shdugra
description_en: Make a day of the Becho valley: a forest walk, a proper lunch break and the lower waterfall viewpoint before heading back. There is no need to add another summit to make this a full day.
details_en: This proposal uses the longer walk from Tvbishi mineral spring to the lower Shdugra viewpoint and back. It leaves time for the valley rather than relying on driving to the furthest possible trailhead. The steeper continuation toward Ushba Glacier is a separate route and is not included.
itinerary_en:
Suggested 7–9 hour day including transfers.
Early morning: Mestia pickup, drive into Becho and start near Tvbishi mineral spring.
Morning: follow the valley trail, with checks at bridges and streams.
Middle of the day: lower waterfall viewpoint and a packed-lunch break at a suitable place.
Afternoon: return by the same path, allowing 5–6 hours for the total walk with breaks, then drive back to Mestia. Keep a turnaround buffer rather than adding the upper glacier route.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: Mestia return transport and a walking guide for the lower viewpoint route. The quote confirms both providers and the actual walking start.
exclusions_en: Meals, drinks, equipment and insurance unless specified. No Ushba glacier extension, horse hire or promised restaurant opening.
requirements_en: Comfort with a long day of uneven walking. Bring walking shoes, rain and warm layers, lunch, drinking water and identification; border patrol may request a passport. Ask about any current document requirements before departure.
base_location: Mestia; walking start at Tvbishi in Becho valley
season_en: June–September target window, subject to bridge, stream and trail checks. May or October requires a separate local assessment.
difficulty: Moderate to demanding; long return walk
meeting_point_en: Mestia pickup; the quote must confirm Tvbishi mineral spring as the planned walking start, or revise the walking statistics if a different start is chosen.
weather_en: Unsafe stream levels, damaged bridges, heavy rain or poor trail conditions mean the waterfall walk is shortened or cancelled. A lower Becho valley visit is an option only if road and local conditions are suitable; otherwise agree a different day. Do not bypass an unsafe crossing to reach the viewpoint.
walking_en: From Tvbishi, allow roughly 13 km return and 5–6 hours with breaks, with about 460 m of ascent on the outward leg. A shorter route from another trailhead needs a revised plan.
driving_en: Mestia–Becho return transfer. The overall day includes a transfer allowance; the driver confirms actual access, drop-off and collection timing.
operator_notes: Confirm guide, vehicle, identification rules and bridge conditions. TCT's named starting point resolves the disagreement with GNTA's shorter route description. If using a drive-assisted start later, edit distance, ascent, duration and meeting point together. Do not advertise the lower-viewpoint plan as an Ushba glacier hike. Season and total day duration are conservative planning choices.

title_en: Four days on foot, Mestia to Ushguli
description_en: Four days, one village at a time. Walk between guesthouse evenings and high mountain views, finishing in Ushguli with plenty to talk about on the road home.
details_en: A proposed guided trek on the traditional village route, with three guesthouse nights and a separately confirmed return transfer. Arrive in Mestia the day before. Leave a flexible day in the wider trip: mountain weather and the Adishchala crossing can change the schedule. The alternative Lagem Pass route is not part of this route. Luggage transport is possible only if explicitly arranged; otherwise guests carry their overnight kit.
itinerary_en:
Before day 1: meet in Mestia for kit, route and weather checks; arrange accommodation here separately.
Day 1: walk Mestia to Zhabeshi, allowing a full day with breaks; first guesthouse night.
Day 2: walk Zhabeshi to Adishi, with time for the climb and a steady descent; second guesthouse night.
Day 3: early departure from Adishi; assess the river before crossing. If safe, continue over Chkhunderi Pass and through Khalde to Iprari; third guesthouse night.
Day 4: walk the traditional route to Ushguli. Return to Mestia only if the agreed walking pace, road and daylight permit; otherwise use the pre-agreed contingency. Daily timing is finalised with the walking guide, not treated as a fixed schedule.
inclusions_en: Proposed package scope: four days with a walking guide, three confirmed guesthouse nights and a return transfer. Rooming, meals, river-crossing arrangements and luggage transport are separate decisions. Only the written, supplier-confirmed quote establishes what is included.
exclusions_en: Mestia arrival night, additional contingency nights, meals, horse assistance, luggage transfer, personal equipment and insurance unless explicitly listed. No glacier travel, summit ascent or Lagem Pass variant.
requirements_en: Recent multi-day hiking experience or equivalent fitness, with confidence on steep and muddy ground. Bring broken-in footwear, waterproofs, warm layers, a suitable pack and the kit agreed with the guide. Declare relevant dietary and accommodation needs before guesthouses are booked. Keep onward travel flexible.
base_location: Mestia to Ushguli; return to Mestia by arranged vehicle
season_en: July–September core window. Early or late season travel needs a new route assessment; it is not a routine extension of the summer itinerary.
duration: 4 walking days / 3 nights; add arrival and buffer time
meeting_point_en: Mestia for a pre-trek briefing on the previous day. The exact day-1 start and return arrangements are confirmed after supplier checks.
weather_en: The Adishchala has no bridge on this route. If the crossing is unsafe, do not cross; horse assistance is not a guarantee of safety. Use the agreed delay, retreat or altered itinerary. Snow, storms and poor visibility can also prevent the pass stage. Contingency nights and transport need an agreed plan and clear costs before departure.
walking_en: About 57 km on the traditional village route across four days, with sustained climbs and descents. Individual stages vary with guesthouse and path choices. A walking guide must confirm each day's route and turnaround rather than relying on a single difficulty label.
driving_en: No driving on the intended walking stages. An Ushguli–Mestia return vehicle is booked separately within the package plan; luggage vehicles and retreat transport require explicit arrangements.
operator_notes: Keep draft until a suitable walking guide and all guesthouses are confirmed. Establish a river go/no-go decision, communication and retreat plan, room/meal terms and budgeted weather buffer. TCT distances for Mestia–Adishi and Adishi–Ushguli sum to 56.7 km; other sources use variants. Do not promise a horse crossing, guaranteed luggage access to every lodging or a tight flight connection after day 4. No guide qualification is implied by this preset.

description_en: Choose one resort and give it the day. Get the transport and meeting arrangements settled first, then spend your time on the snow instead of piecing the morning together.
details_en: A winter resort day at Hatsvali or Tetnuldi, chosen for the group's ability and the pistes actually open. The basic proposal is transport and coordination. Beginners need a separately confirmed onsite instructor and appropriate beginner terrain. Competent skiers may prefer transport only. Off-piste skiing, ski touring and independent winter hikes are outside this offering.
itinerary_en:
Suggested 6–8 hour day; exact times follow current resort operation.
Before departure: confirm road, lifts, pistes, equipment and any instructor meeting.
Morning: Mestia pickup and transfer or station access as agreed; allow time for fitting and tickets.
Resort time: lessons or independent piste skiing according to the confirmed plan, with a lunch break.
Afternoon: meet at the agreed point well before the last usable descent or road departure and return to Mestia. One resort only unless a different plan is quoted.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: resort-day transport and coordination. The quote must name any partner-provided instruction, equipment hire or lift pass and confirm availability. Any lessons are delivered by the named onsite provider.
exclusions_en: Lift passes, equipment, helmets, instruction, food, drinks and insurance unless listed. Off-piste guiding, avalanche equipment and ski touring are not included and are not optional add-ons to this plan.
requirements_en: Tell us every participant's skiing or snowboarding level. Beginners require confirmed instruction and suitable open terrain. Arrange appropriate clothing, fitted equipment and a helmet. Check that personal insurance covers the intended winter activity. Children and any lesson requirements must be agreed with the actual provider.
season_en: January–March is the target core season. Late December and April depend on resort announcements, snow cover and actual operations; no opening date is guaranteed.
meeting_point_en: Confirmed Mestia pickup or lift meeting point. Any lesson has a separate named meeting point and time agreed with the onsite provider.
weather_en: Closed lifts or pistes, poor road access, strong wind or unsuitable visibility can stop the resort day. Reassess before leaving Mestia. Agree another date or a town visit; do not assume the other resort is operating, and do not substitute an off-piste activity.
walking_en: Only access around the resort is planned. Snow and ice may affect footing; the skiing plan depends on individual ability and the actual open pistes.
driving_en: Return access from Mestia to the selected resort or operating lift station. Driver, vehicle, winter equipment and collection time are confirmed for the specific day.
operator_notes: Draft partner-dependent offering. Obtain approval from an actual onsite school/instructor before offering lessons; verify their requirements, availability and terms without inventing credentials. Confirm rental stock, resort status, road restrictions and vehicle winter suitability. MTA's 2025–26 notice proves weather-dependent staged opening, not a reusable future timetable. Core months and full-day allowance are planning choices. Publish no lift price or fixed opening hour from historical notices.
